purpose: Trace the original Applied Commerce concept ancestry of every BIS Lab so teaching, evidence and reporting can share one curriculum source of truth.
interpretationBoundary: An ancestry link identifies where a BIS concept is taught or developed in Applied Commerce. It does not by itself prove learner competence, official external-framework alignment or programme impact.
